newsitem.title: INDIA: RBI policy to help debt, money, forex markets-DSP.
newsitem.headline: RBI policy to help debt, money, forex markets-DSP.

text.p: Hemendra Kothari, chairman of DSP Merrill Lynch Ltd, the Indian arm of the U.S. merchant bank, issued the following commentary on measures announced today by the Reserve Bank of India in its half year credit and monetary policy:
** The policy will go a long way in giving operational freedom to banks and developing the debt, money and forex markets.
** Allowing of repos by non-bank entities is a major step towards debt market liberalisation.
** Operational freedom will allow banks to choose their own risk profile and improve credit delivery.
** Allowing of bridge loans against shares will help companies planning public issues and make it easier for non-prime corporates to access the capital markets.
** Forex markets will deepen as players have been allowed to take long term positions.
** Provided the RBI manages to control inflation, this policy will encourage industrial growth.
